stem:
A cellular process is shown.

Which statement best describes the significance of this process?

options.label: F
options.text: The process allows organisms to grow and heal.

options.label: G
options.text: The process produces clones of the parent organism.

options.label: H
options.text: The process copies DNA before cell division.

options.label: J
options.text: The process creates genetic variation in the resulting cells.

visual_elements: Image of chromosomes showing a process of crossing over or recombination
